fact: On 17 June 2026 a national validation workshop validated the national AI roadmap 2026-2030, drafted by the SPIVTEN under the digital transition ministry; the ministry release calls it a draft validated by stakeholders, not a cabinet approval.
title: IA : le Burkina se dote d'une feuille de route nationale
publisher: Ministère de la Transition digitale, des Postes et des Communications électroniques (DCRP)
